snippet.title: OwlBox - Fantasy Gaming System - DRM-Free - ZOOM Platform Trailer
snippet.description:
OwlBox is a FREE fantasy gaming system with games included!

Available on ZOOM Platform and Itch.io!

https://www.zoom-platform.com/product/owlbox

https://sajbear666.itch.io/owlbox

Under the guidance of the benevolent Mr. Owl, OwlBox will be a platform for small and interesting titles! 

3 games have been included to start and more are to come!

Games Included:
- Legends of Owltopia: The Quest for Mr. Owl
- OwlBoxer
- Owl Bottlecap Mania

Features:
- Cool retro pixel look!
- Cool music!
- Cool sound effects!
- Cool games!

© 2024 Mr. Owl Interactive Entertainment. All Rights Reserved.
